subject: website
name: The Low
summary: The Low, a local news site for Low, Wakefield and the Gatineau Valley, served as plain HTML, CSS and one readable script, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: it asks Open-Meteo's API for the weather when it opens.

connections.name: Open-Meteo weather API (api.open-meteo.com)
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; a server the weather panel relies on and it learns the visit.
